entry.title: Site Update 2026
entry.content:
After several years of neglect this site has a fresh coat of paint!
Warning: RSS feeds have changed, see below.

Theme update #

I've migrated from the serene theme created by isunjn to a personal fork of the newer zola-zap theme from jimmyff. Serene was good enough^tm when I first started the site, it had good support for shortcodes and features that got me off the ground quickly, but it doesn't currently support the latest version of Zola and I've gotten tired of the style. Zap is small, relatively feature complete, and is a lightweight base I can extend easily to fit my own tastes. I won't guarantee my fork will work correctly for anyone else, but it's there if you want inspiration.

Also, I now have a gallery! I'll be posting my photography there. I'm excited to have a place thats fully mine to post photos that I've created and want to share with the rssworld.

Content update #

I want to write more. Will that happen? I'm not sure yet. There's no cadence here.

I have a large backlog of event summaries for the last 10 months that I'm going to try and post eventually.

I will be posting to the gallery more frequently. Gallery posts are included in the atom and rss feeds linked at the bottom of the site. The old blog only feed.xml has been deprecated and will not be updated, but blog-only rss and atom feeds are available (should you not want gallery posts in your rss reader.)

The feeds in the footer include both the blog and gallery.

entry.title: Updates are still slow
entry.summary: I haven't forgotten about this blog, I've just been slow.

entry.title: Hi Again: 2025 Edition
entry.content:
I realized I haven't posted anything on my blog in over 6 months. I'm not dead, I have ideas for posts that I'm working on. I plan to find time to write more in the second half of the year.

I've been writing this blog in my editor (emacs), but I might switch to integrating my blog content with obsidian. I've been using obsidian for my notes, and so far I've been really happy with it.

I might update the site theme too soon and maybe (finally) add multilingual support for some pages. TBD.
